description: Permissions for the in-app DeepSeek platform webview windows (label matches `deepseek-*`). These windows render https://platform.deepseek.com so the user can sign in, mint API keys, and top up without leaving YiYi. They MUST NOT have access to YiYi's IPC, shell, or filesystem — they are pure renderers of third-party web content. Only `core:default` is granted so the window can show + close itself; everything else is denied.
